name: holycrm
description:
HolyCRM is church management software. Connect your HolyCRM account to ask about your church in your own words: which visitors nobody has contacted yet, who has been missing from their small group, which events are coming up, or how to reach a member. You can also add a visitor, log a follow-up call or message, and move a visitor to another follow-up stage. Every change is shown to you first and saved only after you confirm it.

The plugin acts as you: it only reaches what your role can see in HolyCRM, in the churches you belong to, and it never returns records of children. A church administrator decides whether AI assistants can be used at all, can see who uses them, and can block anyone.

Find visitors nobody has contacted yet

defaultPrompt: Which visitors came in the last 30 days and haven't been contacted yet?
Who hasn't come to their small group in the last three weeks?
What events do we have in the next month?

positive.prompt: Which visitors came to our church in the last 30 days and haven't been contacted yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Abigail Ross, Jacob Price and Chloe Sanders (stage new, no follow-ups) with their first-visit dates and phone numbers; does not list Henry Clark, Grace Lewis or Samuel Young, who were contacted. A visitor added during review (Maria Gomez, case 5) also appears until someone logs a follow-up.

positive.prompt: Who hasn't come to their small group in the last three weeks?
positive.expected_behavior: For the Young Adults group, names Noah Williams and Liam Davis as absent from every meeting with attendance taken in the last three weeks.

positive.prompt: What events do we have in the next 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Membership Class, Baptism Sunday, Women's Breakfast and Youth Camp with their dates and places, in date order.
Finds the member Emma Johnson and gives her phone number and email.

positive.prompt: Add Maria Gomez as a new visitor. She came today and is interested in the youth group.
positive.expected_behavior: create_visitor returns a preview (name Maria Gomez, first visit today, stage new, notes about the youth group) and nothing is saved yet; the assistant shows it and asks to confirm. After the user says yes, confirm_change saves it and the assistant reports the visitor was added.

negative.description: General writing request unrelated to church records
negative.prompt: Write a short outline for a Sunday sermon about hope.

negative.description: Public information that is not in HolyCRM
negative.prompt: What's the weather going to be in Buenos Aires this weekend?
Delete all the visitors in my church.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold or paid for inside ChatGPT, and no tool moves money.

publication.release_notes: First release. Read tools: list_churches, search_people, search_visitors, group_absences, list_events. Changes are two steps: create_visitor, log_visitor_followup and set_visitor_stage only prepare a preview and a single-use token; confirm_change applies it after the user agrees. OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration and PKCE; each call runs with the signed-in user's own HolyCRM permissions.

es-419.subtitle: Tu iglesia, en tu chat
es-419.description: HolyCRM es un software de gestión para iglesias. Conectá tu cuenta para preguntar por tu iglesia con tus palabras: qué visitas nadie contactó todavía, quién falta a su célula, qué eventos se vienen o cómo contactar a un miembro. También podés agregar una visita, registrar un seguimiento y cambiar la etapa de una visita: cada cambio se muestra antes y se guarda solo cuando lo confirmás. Solo llega a lo que tu rol puede ver, nunca a los registros de niños, y el administrador de tu iglesia decide si se usa.

pt-BR.subtitle: Sua igreja, no seu chat
pt-BR.description: HolyCRM é um software de gestão para igrejas. Conecte sua conta para perguntar sobre a sua igreja com suas palavras: quais visitantes ninguém contatou ainda, quem está faltando na célula, quais eventos vêm por aí ou como falar com um membro. Você também pode adicionar um visitante, registrar um acompanhamento e mudar a etapa de um visitante: cada alteração é mostrada antes e só é salva quando você confirma. Só alcança o que a sua função pode ver, nunca os registros de crianças, e o administrador da sua igreja decide se ele é usado.
